name: FloatingOrigin3D
author: Twillion
shortDescription: 64-bit double precision coordinates and atomic Jolt Physics / Three.js origin shifting for massive open worlds.
description: Eliminates 32-bit floating-point vertex jitter on 50km+ open worlds by accumulating double-precision world coordinates and atomically re-centering the Three.js scene and Jolt 3D physics worlds every 1km without visual hitching.

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: FloatingOrigin3D
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Coordinates 64-bit double precision tracking and atomic origin shifts for the player camera and physics world.

propertyDescriptors.name: ShiftThreshold
propertyDescriptors.label: Shift Threshold (Meters)
propertyDescriptors.description: Distance in meters from local origin before triggering a silent re-centering shift.

propertyDescriptors.name: StepSize
propertyDescriptors.label: Quantized Step Size (Meters)
propertyDescriptors.description: Quantized snap distance in meters for origin shifts.

propertyDescriptors.name: EnablePhysicsShift
propertyDescriptors.label: Enable Jolt Physics Shift
propertyDescriptors.description: Automatically shifts Jolt 3D Physics simulation bodies synchronously with the scene.

eventsFunctions.name: onCreated
eventsFunctions.description: Initializes the Floating Origin 3D tracker on the object.

eventsFunctions.name: doStepPostEvents
eventsFunctions.description: Checks distance threshold and applies silent origin recentering if exceeded.

eventsFunctions.name: onDestroy
eventsFunctions.description: Cleans up Floating Origin 3D tracking resources.

eventsFunctions.name: ManualShiftOrigin
eventsFunctions.description: Forces an immediate scene and physics origin re-centering based on the object position.

eventsFunctions.name: SetShiftThreshold
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set origin shift threshold distance on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM1_ meters
eventsFunctions.description: Updates the threshold distance in meters before origin shifting occurs.

eventsFunctions.name: HasOriginShifted
eventsFunctions.description: Returns true during the single frame when a Floating Origin shift occurs.

eventsFunctions.name: OriginWorldX
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get true 64-bit world origin X coordinate on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the true cumulative 64-bit world origin X coordinate in meters.

eventsFunctions.name: OriginWorldY
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get true 64-bit world origin Y coordinate on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the true cumulative 64-bit world origin Y coordinate in meters.

eventsFunctions.name: OriginWorldZ
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get true 64-bit world origin Z coordinate on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the true cumulative 64-bit world origin Z coordinate in meters.

eventsFunctions.name: TruePlayerWorldX
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get full double-precision Player X coordinate on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the full double-precision Player X coordinate (OriginWorldX + LocalX).

eventsFunctions.name: TruePlayerWorldY
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get full double-precision Player Y coordinate on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the full double-precision Player Y coordinate (OriginWorldY + LocalY).

eventsFunctions.name: TruePlayerWorldZ
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get full double-precision Player Z coordinate on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the full double-precision Player Z coordinate (OriginWorldZ + LocalZ).
